title: CandidateEnvelope
description: Solar GEPA Optimizer – Candidate Envelope v1 (S03 core-runtime)

candidate_id.description: UUID v4 identifying this candidate instance.

candidate_type.description: Discriminated union tag for the candidate payload shape.

base_object_id.description: ID of the production object this candidate proposes to replace.

parent_candidate_id.description: ID of the parent candidate (null for generation-0 candidates).

generation.description: Mutation depth from the seed candidate (0 = seed).

immutable.description: Hard-policy-pinned fields whose hash is committed at creation time.

hard_policy_refs.description: List of hard policy IDs (e.g. HP-SEC-001) that govern this candidate.

sections.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs whose content is hashed into sha256.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of sections serialised with sort_keys + compact separators.

mutable.description: Content sections that mutation operators are permitted to modify.

sections.description: Mutable payload keyed by section name.

mutation_trace.description: Provenance record for the mutation that produced this candidate.

seed.description: PRNG seed used by the mutation operator for reproducibility.

diff_summary.description: Human-readable description of the diff from the parent candidate.

parent_pareto_rank.description: Pareto rank of the parent candidate at selection time.

signed_by.description: Identity of the system that produced this envelope.
